candidate_evidence.quote: Patients will be randomized to receive either (i) biopsy and LITT, followed by standard CRT or (ii) biopsy alone, followed by standard CRT.
LITT is a minimally invasive neurosurgical procedure in which a laser catheter is placed into the tumor and warms the tumor to such an extent that tumor tissue is destroyed.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Study population: Adult (\>18 years old) patients with a radiologically suspected diagnosis of primary glioblastoma not amenable for surgical resection.

coder_notes: Procedure/device trial: LITT + standard chemoradiation vs biopsy + standard chemoradiation. Chemotherapy drug is not named anywhere in the record (only 'standard CRT' / 'adjuvant treatment'), so no agent row was added (would be temozolomide soc_backbone if named).
